title: Decision tree terms
statement: For each decision tree on $n$ Boolean variables, define a list of conjunctions of literals recursively. A true leaf yields the single empty conjunction, a false leaf yields no terms, and a branch querying variable $v$ yields the terms from its false subtree prefixed by the negated literal for $v$, followed by the terms from its true subtree prefixed by the positive literal for $v$.
